scope: Bounded public runtime, explicit initialization and container packaging

applicationChecks: 136.6 kB initial JS gzip / 350 kB budget

checks: Non-root Node 24 runtime excludes repository, tests, development state and build tools
Explicit initialization publishes a pinned identity using external secret custody
Ordinary API startup refuses an uninitialized volume
A second container cannot take ownership of the same live store
Keyless app container serves the session API through exact-origin scoped boundaries
Every packaged service-worker precache response matches its recorded bytes
SIGKILL/restart reacquires ownership and preserves identity plus the accepted registration attempt
Graceful stop exits cleanly; explicit initialization retry retains the existing identity

limits: Local ARM64 Docker Desktop execution; no registry push or infrastructure deployment.
Fixture HTTP uses the configured HTTPS Host/Origin behind the gateway; no public TLS or real passkey ceremony.
Precache byte integrity was checked; this is not a new browser offline-use campaign.
SIGKILL and graceful process termination were checked; host power-loss durability was not qualified.
No existing Tailscale state, secrets or running processes were used or changed.
Backups, migrations and restore commands remain subsequent implementation phases.
